prompts.label: Split a large task into steps
prompts.text:
I have a large feature to implement in this repo.

- Ask clarifying questions first (max 5)
- Propose 3–5 atomic steps I can run as separate chat messages
- Each step must have: goal, files likely touched, done criteria

Do not write code until I pick a step.

prompts.label: Context + constraints + done criteria
prompts.text:
Rewrite my vague request into a strong Cursor prompt using this skeleton:

- Context (@files I should attach)
- Constraints (style, libs, no new deps unless asked)
- Done criteria (tests, lint, behavior)

Here is my request:
[PASTE HERE]

Output only the improved prompt.

prompts.label: Verify AI answer against repo
prompts.text:
You proposed changes. Before I apply them:

- List assumptions you made about this codebase
- Point to exact files/symbols you would need to confirm
- Suggest 3 grep/search queries I should run

Do not invent file paths.

prompts.label: Plan then code (two-phase)
prompts.text:
Phase 1 — planning only:
- Summarize current behavior from @codebase
- Propose approach with trade-offs (2 options max)
- List risks and test plan

Stop. I will reply GO to start Phase 2 implementation.

prompts.label: Refactor my prompt after bad answer
prompts.text:
The previous answer missed the mark.

- What was wrong (bullets)
- Rewrite my original prompt to prevent that
- Add 2 negative constraints ("do not …")

Original prompt:
[PASTE]

prompts.label: @-mentions checklist
prompts.text:
Explain when to use @file, @folder, @codebase, @docs in Cursor for this task:

[PASTE TASK]

Return a checklist of what to attach and what to paste inline.
Keep it practical — 8 bullets max.

prompts.label: Diff review prompt
prompts.text:
Review this diff like a senior engineer:

- Correctness bugs
- Security issues
- Missing tests
- Naming/style consistency with repo

Ask before suggesting large rewrites.
I will paste the diff next message.

prompts.label: Minimal repro request
prompts.text:
Help me write a minimal repro prompt for a bug:

- Steps to reproduce
- Expected vs actual
- Logs/stack trace placeholders
- Which @files to include

Bug summary:
[PASTE]

prompts.label: Test-first prompt for a fix
prompts.text:
For this bug, draft a test-first Cursor workflow:

1) Write failing test describing bug
2) Implement fix
3) Refactor if needed

Bug:
[PASTE]

Match existing test framework in repo.

prompts.label: Scope guard: small PR
prompts.text:
Implement only this slice in one PR-sized change:

[PASTE SCOPE]

Rules:
- No drive-by refactors
- No new dependencies without asking
- If blocked, stop and list blockers

Start with a 5-line plan.

prompts.label: Explain before edit
prompts.text:
Before changing code, explain in plain language:

- What the selected code does
- Why the bug might happen (hypotheses ranked)
- Smallest safe fix

Then wait for my OK to patch.
@file selection implied.

prompts.label: Generate commit message
prompts.text:
From the staged diff I will describe, suggest:

- One-line conventional commit subject
- 3-bullet body (why, not what)

Diff summary:
[PASTE]

prompts.label: Rules / .cursorrules hint
prompts.text:
Suggest 5–8 project rules for .cursor/rules or AGENTS.md for this stack:

Stack: [PASTE]

Each rule: one sentence, enforceable, not generic platitudes.

prompts.label: Compare two approaches
prompts.text:
Compare approach A vs B for:

[PASTE PROBLEM]

Table: complexity, testability, ops cost, migration risk.
Recommend one with conditions when the other wins.

prompts.label: Document the decision (ADR lite)
prompts.text:
Write a lightweight ADR:

- Context
- Decision
- Consequences
- Alternatives considered

Topic:
[PASTE]

prompts.label: Handoff prompt for new chat
prompts.text:
Summarize this thread into a handoff prompt for a fresh chat:

- Goal
- What was tried
- Current state
- Next 3 actions
- Files touched

Be concise — max 250 words.

prompts.label: Security-sensitive change checklist
prompts.text:
I'm about to change auth/payments/secrets handling.

- Threat model bullets (STRIDE-lite)
- Must-not-break invariants
- Tests to add

Change description:
[PASTE]

prompts.label: Performance investigation prompt
prompts.text:
Draft a performance investigation plan:

- Metrics to measure first
- Likely hotspots in this architecture
- Safe experiments (no premature micro-opts)

Symptom:
[PASTE]

prompts.label: Localization-friendly copy task
prompts.text:
Rewrite UI strings plan:

- Avoid concatenating translated fragments
- Note pluralization pitfalls
- Keep keys stable

Strings/context:
[PASTE]

prompts.label: When to stop and ask human
prompts.text:
Given this task, list signals that the agent should stop and ask me instead of guessing:

[PASTE TASK]

Include 5 concrete examples of ambiguous decisions in this repo domain.
